tools.name: agentcity_list_robinhood_launches
tools.description: Read-only discovery of newly created, near-completion, or graduated Robinhood Chain launchpad tokens. Chain-wide by default; pass launchpads to restrict to Pons or Trench.

tools.name: agentcity_screen_robinhood_launchpads
tools.description: Read-only quality screen across all Robinhood Chain launchpads. Uses GMGN server-side filters; this tool never executes a trade.

tools.name: agentcity_robinhood_trending
tools.description: Read-only Robinhood Chain trending tokens from GMGN.

tools.name: agentcity_research_robinhood_token
tools.description: Read-only multi-source GMGN token due diligence on Robinhood Chain. Returns observations and a deterministic research score, never a trading directive.

tools.name: agentcity_robinhood_token_kline
tools.description: Read-only OHLCV/K-line history for a Robinhood Chain token; useful to distinguish fresh activity from sustained momentum.

tools.name: agentcity_compare_robinhood_tokens
tools.description: Read-only comparison of 2–5 Robinhood Chain token contracts using lightweight GMGN fundamentals and security data.

tools.name: agentcity_robinhood_daily_brief
tools.description: Read-only briefing combining new Robinhood launches, 24-hour trending data, and optionally recent smart-money trades.

tools.name: agentcity_search_robinhood_token
tools.description: Read-only GMGN search for Robinhood Chain tokens by name, symbol, or contract address. Use it to resolve a symbol to candidate contracts; symbols are not unique.

tools.name: agentcity_robinhood_smart_money
tools.description: Read-only feed of recent Robinhood Chain trades by GMGN-tagged smart-money or KOL wallets.

tools.name: agentcity_robinhood_signals
tools.description: Read-only GMGN market signals on Robinhood Chain (e.g. smart-money buys, volume spikes) with optional market-cap bounds.
